Requirement_Title: Shared Context and State Between Agents
Detailed_Requirement_Description: Thread-safe Blackboard architecture with discrete partition spaces (TargetSpace, MutantSpace, CriticSpace, SuiteSpace, MetricsSpace), atomic rollbacks, monotonic revisions, and point-in-time snapshots.
Integration of Model Context Protocol (MCP) stdio JSON-RPC transport with at least 2 distinct tools (Filesystem MCP server and GitHub MCP server) with path confinement and credential protection.
Frontend_UI_Components: MCP Tools Drawer (#mcp-modal), Header Status Pill (#btn-mcp-status)

Requirement_Title: Pydantic Structured Outputs and Final Formats
Detailed_Requirement_Description: Strict Pydantic v2 data models for all inter-agent messages and outputs (GeneratedTestPayload, CriticDirectivePayload, BenchmarkReport, MetricBreakdown) and multiple output formats (JSON, Markdown, Web Dashboard).

Multi-pass agentic reflection cycle: Pass 0 (Zero-shot test generation), Pass 1..N (Adversarial mutation analysis, Critic diagnostic directives, Generator targeted patch synthesis, Clean reference validation).
Event-driven CallbackRegistry supporting lifecycle events (step_start, step_end, agent_message, tool_start, tool_end, error) with in-memory ring buffers and WebSocket/SSE streaming to UI.
Frontend_UI_Components: Observability Trace (tab-telemetry), Real-time Terminal Log Container

Detailed_Requirement_Description: Adherence to official Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol specification v0.3.0, including AgentCard schema at /.well-known/agent.json, capability discovery, and task delegation endpoints.
Frontend_UI_Components: A2A Agent Card Modal (#a2a-modal), Header Button (#btn-a2a-card)

Requirement_Title: Both Google ADK and CrewAI Integration
Detailed_Requirement_Description: Dual-framework agent orchestration: Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) powering test generation and CrewAI powering adversarial critic review, with no unauthorized 3rd agent framework.
Multi-layered security defense: Pre-execution AST validator blocking dangerous calls (os.system, subprocess, eval, open outside root), timeout bounded subprocessing, and sensitive secret redaction.
Frontend_UI_Components: Settings Security Policies, Error alerts on unsafe code upload

Detailed_Requirement_Description: Rigorous 3-way ablation comparison: Handwritten baseline vs Zero-shot prompt vs Multi-pass Agentic Reflection across standardized test fixtures with mutation score and defect detection metrics.
Distributed trace correlation IDs, OpenTelemetry semantic metadata, chronological step execution timelines, token usage tracking, and reproducible audit logs.
Repeatable runtime/cost profiling with token usage metrics, production Docker containerization (Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml), health check endpoints (/readyz), and graceful shutdown.
Frontend_UI_Components: Benchmarks & Ablation (tab-benchmark), Health indicator in Header
